title: No glucose values in G6 after calibrating: Confused Calibration 1
symptom: After calibrating a new Dexcom G6 sensor, no glucose readings are received and the app shows 'Confused Calibration 1'. The Event Log is crowded with 'Encountered backfill data we don't recognize: 85 127'. The XDrip algorithm works but shows higher values than real ones.
cause: The transmitter will not accept huge calibration variances.
fix: Recalibrate with the official Dexcom app, which will take multiple finger sticks and several hours, to reset the sensor. When returning to XDrip, disable all automatic restarts, especially preemptive restart with time travel.
evidence_quote: Try recalibrating with the official Dexcom app. It will take multiple finger sticks and several hours, but that should reset the sensor. When you return to Xdrip disable all automatic restarts, especially preemptive restart with time travel. In essence the transmitter will not accept huge calibration variances.
